name: Balanced Dollar
oneLiner: This entry tracks Balanced v1 bnUSD(old), issued on ICON and moving to the distinct Sonic-based bnUSD through a 1:1 migration.
collateral: Tracked v1 bnUSD(old) is backed through the ICON Balanced Loans and Peg Stability contracts. The Sonic SODAX borrower-collateral census describes the distinct new bnUSD and is not a verified composition of this legacy liability.
pegMechanism: The legacy ICON token uses Balanced Loans and Peg Stability contracts and xCall burn-mint representations. Issuer documentation offers a 1:1 migration into the distinct new bnUSD; current v2 Stability Fund capacity is not attributed to this legacy token.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Balanced describes bnUSD as a crypto-backed stablecoin minted through collateralized positions and its Stability Fund. This is a collateralized-debt-position stabilization path, so the CDP archetype is the supported classification; the current collateral allocation remains separately bounded by the reserve review.

notices.title: Primary issuance lives on ICON
notices.message: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical contract cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb). Balanced uses its xCall infrastructure to extend the same supply to other chains, so the Archway, Havah, EVM, and Injective contracts tracked here are cross-chain burn-mint representations of the ICON-issued supply. ICON, Archway, and Havah deployments were added after their chain mappings and connected-contract identities were verified on 2026-08-11; these chains do not have token-pool providers, so contract-level runtime balance queries remain unsupported.

notices.title: Balanced v1 transition and v2 launch
notices.message: Balanced v2 launched on April 7, 2026 and the original v1 app is no longer supported. Issuer documentation asks holders to withdraw or migrate before v1 goes offline on December 1, 2026; after that date, outstanding loans will be liquidated and contracts made inaccessible ahead of ICON's announced end-2026 shutdown. This entry tracks v1 bnUSD(old), not the distinct Sonic-based new bnUSD. The Sonic v2 reserve census does not establish backing or redemption capacity for the tracked legacy liability.

suspended.reason: Tracked ICON bnUSD(old) and its burn-mint representations are a different liability from the Sonic SODAX new bnUSD reserve census. Resume only after identity-bound legacy backing evidence is reviewed.
